content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-explained-digital-creators-3|COREMERCH guide to selling]] digital products without relying on platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Paddle is a necessity for many creators in restricted countries. These platforms often exclude users based on location, which results in millions of creators being unable to monetize their skills. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to set up their own stores without these limitations. This infrastructure ensures that creators can accept payments in cryptocurrency, enabling them to maintain control over their earnings and avoid issues like account suspensions that can freeze funds for extended periods.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on a combination of free and open-source tools that work together seamlessly. For instance, by using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing, creators can establish a fully functional online store. This architecture eliminates reliance on third-party platforms, allowing creators to handle transactions directly. The integration of decentralized payment solutions, such as cryptocurrencies, further enhances the system's resilience and accessibility, making it suitable for creators in regions often neglected by traditional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who are unable to use conventional payment platforms due to geographic restrictions. Creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products can significantly benefit from this model. By utilizing sovereign commerce infrastructure, they gain complete ownership over their business processes, eliminating any dependency on external payment processors. This independence is crucial for creators in countries with unstable financial systems or high levels of economic exclusion, ensuring they retain full access to their earnings.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers you to own your digital sales process completely.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of sovereign commerce infrastructure lies in its carefully selected components. The hosting is provided by platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which are cost-free and reliable. For managing backend logic, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers are employed for their flexibility and ease of integration. Order and data management can be handled through Supabase or Google Sheets, both of which are accessible and user-friendly. Finally, NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions with minimal fees, ensuring that the payment process is efficient and secure. Together, these components create a cohesive solution that empowers creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure today, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Choose a database solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, to store your orders. Integrate NOWPayments to handle your cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you have a system in place for payment verification. Finally, load your products into the store and test the entire system before going live. This approach allows you to create a fully functional online store in as little as 48 hours.
